definitionZh: 边距-块 CSS 的短手属性定义了元素的逻辑块起始和结尾边距,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边距.
sourceDefinition: The margin-block CSS shorthand property defines the logical block start and end margins of an element, which maps to physical margins depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
